description: <<- ignores a whitespace-only line that is less indented than the other lines
notes:
The spec says the leading spaces of the literal text starting each line are analyzed and that the minimum is removed from every such line, without mentioning blank lines. hashicorp/hcl skips lines that contain only whitespace, both when finding the minimum and when removing it (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go). Counting the whitespace-only line would make the minimum two spaces, giving "  a

  b
".
